quickAnswers.question: What do the Pending and Assigned ticket statuses mean?
quickAnswers.answer: A Pending ticket has not yet been assigned to a sheet. An Assigned ticket is already linked to an expense sheet. To change that relationship, the current process is to delete the ticket, upload it again, and link it to the appropriate expense sheet.

topics.title: The page does not open
topics.summary: Check the connection and address, retry safely, and report useful details.

quickAnswers.question: What should I do if the CRM page does not open?
quickAnswers.answer: 1. Check that the device has a connection. 2. Check that the address (https://crm.insertec.biz:7702/) is complete and contains no spaces. 3. Press Refresh once and wait. 4. If the problem continues, close and reopen the browser, then retry. 5. If other pages work but the CRM does not, report the time, address, and displayed message.

topics.title: Sign-in repeats
topics.summary: Retry with the correct corporate account and avoid repeated password attempts.

quickAnswers.question: What should I do if sign-in keeps repeating?
quickAnswers.answer: Close all CRM tabs, check that you are using the correct corporate account, and sign in again through the official access method. Do not try passwords repeatedly. If the account is locked or verification fails, contact support.

topics.title: A menu, button, or user is missing
topics.summary: Check the active company, permissions, and management hierarchy.

quickAnswers.question: Why is a menu, button, or user missing?
quickAnswers.answer: Check the active company and refresh the screen. If the option still does not appear, this may be due to permissions or the management hierarchy. Do not use another person's session.

topics.title: Unable to save
topics.summary: Review required fields, amounts, currency, status, and permissions.

quickAnswers.question: What should I check if I cannot save?
quickAnswers.answer: Review required fields and messages shown in red. In Visits, check Account, Visit type, Description, and Comments. On a new sheet, check Description; the company provides Reimbursement currency. On a line or ticket, check Date, Category, amounts, and currency. A disabled button may mean the record is read-only because of its status, payment, or permissions.

topics.title: The ticket image is not processed
topics.summary: Check file limits and camera permission, then retry with a clear image.

quickAnswers.question: What should I do if the ticket image is not processed?
quickAnswers.answer: 1. Check that the image uses a supported format and does not exceed the application limit. 2. Grant camera permission only when the browser requests it for the CRM. 3. Take a new photo with even lighting, all information visible, and no glare. 4. If Retry upload appears, use it once and wait. 5. If a partial ticket was created, note its identifier before closing the message.

topics.title: Information to send to support
topics.summary: Collect the context and error evidence support needs, without sharing secrets.

quickAnswers.question: What information should I send to support?
quickAnswers.answer: Your corporate username without your password; active company; module and action; visit, sheet, or ticket identifier when available; approximate date and time; full error message; and a screenshot that does not show passwords, access codes, or unnecessary data.
